attempts.text:
VIVEK VISHNUKANT MISHRA
Mumbai | +91 7841074082 | vmishra0222@gmail.com

Derivatives trader with nearly four years on proprietary desks at Jainam Broking and Mansukh Securities, trading Nifty, Sensex and Bank Nifty
options and stock options. Work with option Greeks, hedges and spread payoffs every day. Built Calendar Scope, an options spread scanner
prototype, by defining the requirements and calculation logic and testing the output. Looking to move into middle office, trade support,
market surveillance or risk operations.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

JAINAM BROKING LIMITED – Dealer, Proprietary Trading Desk | Mumbai December 2025–Present

• Trade Nifty, Sensex and Bank Nifty options and stock options, intraday and positional, with about ₹1.3 crore of
allocated margin.

• Monitor margin usage, MTM and daily P&L to stay within desk exposure and loss limits.
• Track Delta, Gamma, Theta and Vega across multiple expiries and adjust hedges as the market moves.
• Manage expiry-day exposure through position monitoring, square-offs and rolls.
• Check executed trades against contract notes and closing terminal positions; report to the desk head.
• Discuss trade ideas, risks and post-trade observations with desk colleagues.

MANSUKH SECURITIES & FINANCE LIMITED – Derivatives Trader | Mumbai December 2022–November 2025

• Traded index and stock options, intraday and positional, with about ₹1 crore of allocated margin.
• Picked setups using market structure, volatility and macro events, and compared premiums, spreads and payoffs.
• Managed Greeks and hedges across multiple expiries, including expiry-day square-offs and rolls.
• Resolved order rejections and corrected price or quantity discrepancies.
• Reviewed daily trades and closing positions against contract notes and the terminal.
• Monitored margin and MTM against exposure and loss limits.

PERSONAL PROJECT

Calendar Scope – Options Spread Scanner
Personal project | In progress

• Defined requirements and calculation logic for comparing option premiums, calendar spreads and diagonals across
strikes and expiries.

• Specified individual-leg and combined-spread bid, ask and last-traded prices, along with delta, implied volatility
and premium comparisons.

• Used AI coding tools to develop the prototype. Tested outputs against market quotes and identified issues with
strike selection, stale prices and spread calculations.

EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS

• Bachelor of Commerce (2019–2022)
M.P.V. Valia College of Commerce | CGPA: 7.6

• Certifications: NISM Series VIII – Equity Derivatives (2026); Introduction to SQL Certificate (2026)

SKILLS

• Trade monitoring: Margin usage, MTM, daily P&L, exposure limits and expiry-day position management.
• Analysis: Greeks, hedging, premium, spread and payoff analysis; calendar and diagonal spreads.
• Tools: Microsoft Excel; SQL (introductory).
